name: Dihydromorphine
summary: Dihydromorphine (Paramorfan, Paramorphan) is a semi-synthetic opioid structurally related to and derived from morphine. The 7,8-double bond in morphine is reduced to a single bond to get dihydromorphine. Dihydromorphine is a moderately strong analgesic and is used clinically in the treatment of pain and also is an active metabolite of the analgesic opioid drug dihydrocodeine.

pharmacology.text: Dihydromorphine acts as an agonist at the μ-opioid with a Ki value of 2.5 nM compared to 4.9 nM of morphine, δ-opioid with a Ki value of 137 nM compared to 273 nM of morphine and κ-opioid with a Ki value of 223 nM compared to 227 nM of morphine. Dihydromorphine is therefore slightly more μ-selective than morphine.
